<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Welcome to Spanish Learning Academy’s Beginner Spanish for Professionals course.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="In this course, you'll learn the essentials of navigating Spanish conversations with clients, stakeholders, and coworkers.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Before we begin, here are a few tips to help you get the most out of this lesson.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="This lesson takes approximately 15 minutes to complete.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="For the best listening experience, we recommend using headphones.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="As you learn, repeat each sound aloud as you hear it. This will help strengthen your pronunciation and listening comprehension.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="When you're ready, select the Next button to begin.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Let’s take a quick look at what you'll learn today.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to: recognize the five Spanish vowel sounds, practice pronouncing each vowel aloud, use those sounds to begin reading Spanish words, and build a strong foundation for natural Spanish pronunciation.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="When you're ready, select the Next button to continue." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="¡Felicidades! Congratulations on completing your first Spanish lesson!
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Today you successfully recognized the five Spanish vowel sounds, practiced pronouncing each one aloud, applied your listening skills in the Puerto Rican Market, and most importantly, you've built a strong foundation for speaking Spanish confidently. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="These vowel sounds are the key to clear Spanish pronunciation, and you'll continue building on them throughout the rest of this course.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Take a moment to celebrate your progress. You've earned it!
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="When you're ready, select the Next button to continue to Lesson Two. ¡Hasta la próxima!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Thank you for completing this lesson! 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="You may now close your browser window or select the Next button to continue to Lesson 2. " /> </Block> </Content> </Document>
